platform: office (un-ihe 100.120.94.49, Win11, i9-11900H 8c/16t, 32GB RAM, RTX A2000 Laptop 4GB, NVMe)
notes: First attempt with -ngl 99 failed: cudaMalloc OOM (tried to allocate 19.9GB on 4GB A2000). Rerun with -ngl 6 succeeded; GPU holds layers 0-5, rest CPU.
Stall tail is 30-300x the median op time: cold mmap page-ins of expert weights from the 21.7GB file (max single-op stall 406ms). This is the remora prefetch target.
Router is very flat: 0% exact same-topk persistence across consecutive tokens (LFM pilot: 4%), 21.5% Jaccard (LFM: 32%), entropy 91-98% of uniform max, all 256 experts used within 76 tokens.
Naive same-top-k prefetch would have ~0 hit rate on this model; supports the learned-observer claim.
First analysis script had a units bug (us/1e6 labelled 'ms'); corrected here (us/1e3 = ms).
